title: Guard fixtures against real transcript commits
description:
Add a lint guard (path allowlist or content heuristics) preventing real transcripts from being committed under tests/fixtures/sentiment/: fixtures must stay synthetic and hand-authored. Real transcripts from Ryan's Macs are used for verification locally only, and only aggregate numbers are recorded.

Done when: the guard runs in CI and rejects fixture files that look like real session dumps; the fixture README rule is enforced.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Done. scripts/guard-sentiment-fixtures.ts rejects files >1MB, >5000 lines, lines >100KB, or binary/db extensions under tests/fixtures/sentiment; fixture-guard.spec.ts verifies committed corpus passes and synthetic dumps are rejected. Removed the CLI script shebang so ts-jest can import runCli. Lint back to the single pre-existing benchmark error.
